question: Did Christians worship on Sunday or keep the Sabbath?

answers.label: They gathered on the Lord's day, Sunday, the day of the resurrection
Some also kept honor for the Sabbath

overview.text: From the first generation after the apostles, Christians gathered on "the Lord's day", the day of the resurrection: the Didache, Ignatius, Barnabas and Justin all say so, long before Constantine.
Some Christians still rested on the Sabbath in the fourth century, and the Council of Laodicea told them not to judaize, while keeping Gospel readings on Saturday.

quotes.author: Didache
quotes.english: On the Lord's day of the Lord, gather together, break bread and give thanks.
quotes.original: Κατὰ κυριακὴν δὲ κυρίου συναχθέντες κλάσατε ἄρτον καὶ εὐχαριστήσατε
quotes.context: "The Lord's day" (kyriake) is already the name of the day, as in Revelation 1:10.

quotes.author: Ignatius of Antioch
quotes.english: If, then, those who lived in the old ways came to newness of hope, no longer keeping the Sabbath but living by the Lord's day, on which our life also rose through him and his death ...
quotes.original: Εἰ οὖν οἱ ἐν παλαιοῖς πράγμασιν ἀναστραφέντες εἰς καινότητα ἐλπίδος ἦλθον, μηκέτι σαββατίζοντες, ἀλλὰ κατὰ κυριακὴν ζῶντες, ἐν ᾗ καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἡμῶν ἀνέτειλεν δἰ αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ
quotes.context: "Those who lived in the old ways" may mean the prophets or Jewish believers.

quotes.author: Letter of Barnabas
quotes.english: That is why we keep the eighth day with gladness, the day on which Jesus also rose from the dead, and appeared, and ascended into heaven.
quotes.original: διὸ καὶ ἄγομεν τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ὀγδόην εἰς εὐφροσύνην, ἐν ᾗ καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνέστη ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ φανερωθεὶς ἀνέβη εἰς οὐρανούς.
quotes.context: "The eighth day": the day after the Sabbath, the start of a new creation.

quotes.author: Justin Martyr
quotes.english: On the day called the day of the Sun, all who live in towns or the country gather in one place.
quotes.original: Καὶ τῇ τοῦ ἡλίου λεγομένῃ ἡμέρᾳ πάντων κατὰ πόλεις ἢ ἀγροὺς μενόντων ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ συνέλευσις γίνεται
quotes.context: Justin explains to pagans why: it is the first day, on which God made the world and Christ rose (67.7).

quotes.author: Council of Laodicea
quotes.english: Christians must not judaize and rest on the Sabbath, but work on that day; preferring the Lord's day, they should rest then, if they can, as Christians. If any are found to be judaizers, let them be anathema from Christ.
quotes.original: Ὅτι οὐ δεῖ Χριστιανοὺς ἰουδαΐζειν καὶ ἐν τῷ σαββάτῳ σχολάζειν, ἀλλ᾽ ἐργάζεσθαι αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ ἡμέρᾳ· τὴν δὲ Κυριακὴν προτιμῶντας, εἴγε δύναιντο, σχολάζειν ὡς Χριστιανοί. Εἰ δὲ εὐρεθεῖεν Ἰουδαϊσταί, ἔστωσαν ἀνάθεμα παρὰ Χριστῷ.
quotes.context: The canon shows some Christians were still resting on the Sabbath. Other Laodicean canons honor Saturday with Gospel readings (16) and the Eucharist in Lent (49).

quotes.author: Council of Laodicea
quotes.english: On the Sabbath the Gospels are to be read with the other Scriptures.
quotes.original: Περὶ τοῦ ἐν σαββάτῳ Εὐαγγέλια μετὰ ἑτέρων γραφῶν ἀναγινώσκεσθαι.
quotes.context: In the East, Saturday kept a special honor beside Sunday. It still has no fasting in Orthodox practice.

quotes.author: Seventh-day Adventist Church
quotes.english: The fourth commandment of God's unchangeable law requires the observance of this seventh-day Sabbath as the day of rest, worship, and ministry in harmony with the teaching and practice of Jesus, the Lord of the Sabbath.
quotes.original: The fourth commandment of God's unchangeable law requires the observance of this seventh-day Sabbath as the day of rest, worship, and ministry in harmony with the teaching and practice of Jesus, the Lord of the Sabbath.
quotes.context: The Adventist confession (adopted 1980, wording maintained since): the seventh day, not the first, is still the Sabbath, and Adventists keep it from Friday sunset to Saturday sunset.

source.edition: Seventh-day Adventist Church, Fundamental Beliefs, 20: The Sabbath (official text, adventist.org)

gaps.author: Constantine
gaps.work: Law of 321 on the venerable day of the Sun (Codex Justinianus 3.12.2)
gaps.why: The first civil law of rest on Sunday.

gaps.author: Pliny the Younger
gaps.why: Christians met "on a fixed day". Used under question 48.
